critical_steps: Both approximate-duality reconstruction errors are exactly one half.
The generalized inverse has norm two, and the normalized mixed reconstruction operator is a rank-one projection.
The proposed K-frame sequence annihilates a vector on which K is nonzero.
Injectivity plus the generalized-inverse identity gives K-dagger K equal to the identity, making the repaired defect estimate exact at the operator level.
integrity.proof_basis: Exact two-dimensional Banach-space counterexample and a direct Neumann-series repair.
integrity.unproved_limits: No necessity characterization for invertibility beyond the universal Neumann-type sufficient condition is asserted.

scientific_limitations: The repaired norm-product condition is a sufficient universal threshold, not a necessary condition for each individual mixed reconstruction operator.
The finding is confined to Lemma 19 and Proposition 20; downstream statements that use the same inverse are not separately assessed.
An unindexed erratum, thesis remark, or informal correction may contain the same observation.
title: Approximate \(K\)-duality needs generalized-inverse-scaled error
